items.summary: Recommendation: retain the financial and implementation gates and approve only the bounded read-only Save Us Farms inspection. Reject revenue, contribution-margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, forecast, budget-exposure, and causal-lift claims this cycle. Amazon data for 2026-09-21 reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all on aggregate tracking_id other; site-attributed income is $0. AI usage for 2026-10-01 is $34.69846565 across 223 calls and 20 observed sites versus 38 expected, with 3 errors. Contribution margin is not calculable because revenue and AI spend are period-misaligned, AI allocation is incomplete, infrastructure/domain costs and budgets are absent, and aggregate commission cannot be assigned. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because one-day AI spend cannot be causally matched to the 30-day outcome deltas. Budget exposure is not calculable because monthly spend, infrastructure, domain, and marketing budgets are blank. Minimum measurement: a common-period site/content ledger linking registered affiliate IDs, revenue, ordered and shipped items, AI cost, infrastructure/domain cost, and experiment exposure/outcome data. Clicks, impressions, sessions, and conversion counts remain operating signals, not financial results.
